templates.description: One search for every step of a run: the configured index and sourcetype(s), any event carrying a step marker, or (for steps with IP signatures only) the step's IP pair.
templates.spl: index={index} {sourcetype_filter} ({step_filter}) earliest={earliest} latest={latest} | table {fields} | sort 0 -_time | head {limit}

templates.description: One search over the remembered locations only: the exact index and sourcetype where a detection was found before, the step markers, and a tight time window.
Every alert naming one of the given hosts in a time range. Used to compare a step's window with a quiet window when an alert carries no step marker.
templates.spl: index={index} {sourcetype_filter} ({host_filter}) earliest={earliest} latest={latest} | table {fields} | sort 0 -_time | head {limit}
